H01.label: an out-of-window event counted (no format reason)

skeptic.notes: Window [18:00Z on 12 Apr, 01:25Z on 13 Apr). Distinct earthquakes inside it: (1) ak53937112 18:05:01Z, with us6530aeef "same event as ak53937112"; (2) ak65752034 18:30:03Z, with the [US] preliminary under the same ID; (3) nc44871449 18:41:44Z, with ew74910210 "same event as nc44871449" (10:41 AM UTC-08 = 18:41Z); (4) ak52054996 09:32 (UTC-10) = 19:32Z; (5) nc46687735 19:57:44Z; (6) pr81889138 18:49 (UTC-04) = 22:49Z, with the [EW] preliminary under the same ID at 22:49:57Z. us6814g32r (23:08Z) is retracted. RETRACTED' retraction once in about 115 (inst-031 v0 Q4).
